mapper.sql: EMP_NO, START_DATE, JOB_ID, DEPT_NM, SALARY, CLASS, NOTE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EMP_HIST (EMP_NO, START_DATE, JOB_ID, DEPT_NM, SALARY, CLASS, NOTE) VALUES (#{empNo}, #{startDate}, #{jobId}, #{deptNm}, #{salary}, #{class_}, #{note})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_EMP_HIST WHERE EMP_NO = #{empNo} AND START_DATE = #{startDate}
